'''Lucky implings''' are a type of [[impling]] that can be caught in the [[Impetuous Impulses]] [[minigame]], and are located throughout [[Puro-Puro]] and [[Gielinor]]. Players need at least 89 [[Hunter]] to capture this type of impling with a [[butterfly net]] or a [[magic butterfly net]], or 99 Hunter to capture it barehanded.

==Rarity==
{{Main|Impling#Spawn_mechanics}}
On the Gielinor surface, lucky implings have a 1/101 chance to appear out of a high-tier invisible spawn. In Puro-Puro however, a lucky impling only has a 1/301 chance to emerge from one of the high-tier invisible spawns.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/863355929772920832|date=13 May 2017|archiveurl=https://archive.fo/TJqoz|archivedate=8 August 2019|quote=1/101, or 1/301 in the maze.}} These rates make the lucky impling about nine times rarer than a [[dragon impling]] in Puro-Puro, and ten times rarer on the surface of Gielinor.

For a more detailed breakdown of impling spawn mechanics, see the main article.

The chance of successfully catching a lucky impling is between ~35% at level 89 and ~39% at level 99.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1573634900921573377|date=24 September 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/96595|archivedate=30 September 2022}}

When catching barehanded or with a [[magic butterfly net]], the catch chance is increased by 7.8%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1413192817275457546|date=8 July 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104105|archivedate=21 May 2022|quote=For barehanded or a magic net, add 8 percentage points to the chances - which means you do get a no-fail chance.}}

==Loot==
{{Main|Treasure Trails#Rewards}}

Looting a lucky impling gives players one roll on the drop table of an [[clue scroll (easy)|easy]], [[clue scroll (medium)|medium]], [[clue scroll (hard)|hard]], [[clue scroll (elite)|elite]], or [[clue scroll (master)|master clue scroll]]. There is an equal chance of rolling into each tier's clue scroll table.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1159178762455519232|date=1 October 2016|archiveurl=https://archive.fo/kH8SY|archivedate=8 August 2019|quote=It rolls the easy, medium, hard, elite or master clue lists with equal chance of each.}}

At current [[Grand Exchange]] prices, catching a lucky impling gives {{NoCoins|{{ImpValue|Lucky}} round 0|c}} worth of loot, on average. Rolling one of the many unique clue scroll items will also unlock the [[Collection log]] slot, where applicable.

Although looting a lucky impling has a chance of rolling the master clue scroll table, it is not possible to receive a [[bloodhound]] pet when doing so. Similarly, it is not possible to receive a master clue scroll as a result of opening a lucky impling jar.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1114688438534594561|date=7 April 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/96799|archivedate=4 November 2022|quote=[Would it be possible to get a master clue scroll from a lucky imp since they give a random clue reward?] I'm afraid that - and the dog - are not on their list as far as I know.}}
